added_failures_source.absence_control: a missing log returns (None, []) — unmeasured, never a measured zero
added_failures_source.arms_green: both arm logs end green with exit 0 over the same two regression files (26 passed at base, 31 at head with the new file added), so nothing the base arm ran was red at head
added_failures_source.count_derivation: set difference of FAILED/ERROR node ids over the reviewed run's own base-arm.log and head-arm.log, computed with review.added_failures_from_gate_logs (review run log logs-added-failures-derivation.log:12); the reviewed manifest's baseline_suite/after_suite hold prose, so annotate_review_of_run resolves no log and renders this count unmeasured in the read-time view while the stored record keeps it

positive_control.mutation: the reviewed run's own negative-control log (exact-equality checkout check restored) taken as the head arm: the extractor sees exactly the one failing node, so it is not blind

added_failures_source.store_view: read through read_review, annotate_review_of_run overwrites the stored count with the manifest-derived reading (None) and adds added_failures_note; the stored count and this source block survive on disk, which is why they are recorded here

findings.text: the added _revision_is_ancestor is dead code: a module-level _revision_is_ancestor already exists at :5233 and Python binds the later definition, so the call at :1137 reaches that one (measured: promotion._revision_is_ancestor.__code__.co_firstlineno is 5233) and the added function can never execute, and the executed helper also raises CrewError on a git fault where the added one would answer False, so what a reader reviews is not what runs.

the ladder refuses an unknown scope only when changed_paths is None (:1185), but _paths_differing_between returns None both for that route and when its git probe fails (:1007); on the probe-failure route differing is None while changed_paths is set, so the ladder falls to reason = None at :1205 and the gate runs on a checkout whose path comparison was never taken, while the report prints "changed_paths_differing": [] at :1151 — a measured empty — contradicting the helper's own docstring at :988 that an unknown scope is not an empty one.

the refusal for a checkout past the merge whose run paths are unknown has no test: the only verify-gate tests always cite a resolvable commit (tests/test_bookkeeping_follows_the_run.py:267), so this branch can be deleted without the suite noticing even though it is the branch the fail-open at :1205 bypasses.

the arm that claims a run with no stored review is still refused writes its pointer with the defaults role="implement" and node_id="node-a" (:100, :103), so it exercises the generic non-passing-gate refusal at reckon/crew/promotion.py:3052 rather than the review-run refusal at :3060, which the new file never reaches.

the reviewed manifest's baseline_suite/after_suite lines hold prose rather than armed JSON, so review._gate_log_path returns the whole sentence as a log path and the store's read-time derivation reports the run unmeasured (added_failure_count None, note "unmeasured: the reviewed manifest names no base gate log"), disarming the added-failure annotation and the score cap for every reader even though the run's own arm logs show zero added failures.
